profile_text.body:
Inceptive describes itself as building foundation models of life, models it says extrapolate from data to design medicines for humanity's most challenging diseases. The company is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. It describes its team as antedisciplinary, made up of scientists, AI researchers, and engineers who work together on what it calls "the beach," where wet and dry meet. It says it is hiring scientists and engineers across AI and bio.

On partnerships, Inceptive says it treats them as strategic alliances, working over time to tune models, use data, and transfer knowledge, and it invites discussion of how its team and technology can support an AI investment and pipeline. Its stated aim is for AI models to learn the mechanisms of life and design novel therapies.

The company's record here lists no products and no MCP servers, and no lawsuits involving it. Its only geographic entry is California.
